</text>

</text>

</text>

sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: One CouplingLayer direct profile; optional condition concat and inverse are excluded.

sourceFacts: Source mask is an ordinary tensor attribute, not a registered buffer. Selected mask retains entries 0 and 2.
The two MLPs are independent. Their outputs are masked with 1-mask, which makes the retained entries identity.
This implementation uses exp(log_s) and x*s+t, unlike the Glow sigmoid and shift-then-scale form.
Inner init(m) is defined but never applied; do not claim orthogonal initialization.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
